title: W2 rewrite flips unknown-status slot semantics in trigger.is_terminal from fail-closed (live) to fail-open (terminal)
evidence:
fn is_terminal(status: String) -> Bool {
  is_terminal_status(status_from_string(status))
}
---
    "failed" -> Failed
    _ -> Failed
---
          && !is_terminal(row.status)
detail: Pre-fix, an unrecognised status string missed the terminal list, so find_live_row_for_slot returned the row and skip/trigger returned 409. Now unknown -> Failed -> terminal -> slot free, so a duplicate row can be created for a mid-flight row in an expand-then-contract window. The fix commit's docs call the Failed fallback inert; here it is decision-bearing.
recommended_fix: Treat unrecognised strings as live in this context: compare against the known status-string set before applying the shared truth, or pin the explicit list against the shared fn (r1's option 2), preserving unknown -> live.

title: Lockstep direction 2 hardcodes a 14-string list nothing pins — a new terminal status can still drift out of terminal_statuses undetected
detail: The shared round-trip test pins variant-to-string mapping only; nothing forces this hand-maintained list to grow. A new terminal status omitted from terminal_statuses passes both directions — the mirror-drift class AR-RC13 names, relocated into the test. The comment overstates the pin.
recommended_fix: Export the status-string set (or all_statuses()) from shared production code and derive direction 2 from it, so a new enum value reaches the lockstep without manual list edits.

title: lint_refcheck_hooks false-positives on a legitimately hook-gated multi-subject case
evidence:
if tok in ("|", ",", ":"):
            pending_case = None
            continue
---
                seq = pending_case
                if seq == ["call.hooks.can_take_over"]:
                    gate = "can_take_over"
detail: Sandbox-verified: `case call.hooks.can_take_over, x { True, 1 -> [RefcheckTakeOver] ... }` exits 1 — the comma clears pending_case so the gate is never recognised, flagging legal gated construction. The nested-case false positive (r1 N1) is fixed; this new shape is not.
recommended_fix: Accumulate case subjects across commas up to the opening brace and match a hook subject at any position; add a CI negative-control fixture covering multi-subject cases.

title: FIX-AUDIT [N7]: substitute/take-over message-payload construction remains shape-exempt from the hooks lint — its gate is still code-review-only
evidence:
- Call arguments (`UserChoseRefcheckAction(..., RefcheckSubstitute)`) -
---
            # `(` call arg / `{` import / top-level: exempt by shape
---
            event.on_click(msg.UserChoseRefcheckAction(
              call.reference_call_id,
              RefcheckSubstitute,
            )),
detail: Sandbox-verified: an ungated `UserChoseRefcheckAction(_, RefcheckTakeOver)` passes the lint. The fix documented the exemption (docstring cites N7) but the structural gap remains — a future un-gated message-payload construction ships past CI, which was the finding's core claim.
recommended_fix: Track gate membership across `(` too: treat the action constructor's call-argument position as a construction site requiring an enclosing hooks gate, or move the construction below the gate.
